papers.title_en: Algorithmic Optimality Guarantees for Nonsmooth $H_\infty$ Output-Feedback Policy Search
papers.evidence: 非光滑非凸策略搜索的收敛速率保证
papers.tldr: 连续时间全阶动态输出反馈 H∞ 策略搜索是非凸非光滑问题，直接策略搜索缺乏严格保证。本文在扩展凸提升的精确 identity-gauge 切片上，证明 ε-平稳性可推出紧致切片上的 O(ε) 次优性。由此得到非光滑策略搜索的收敛速率，并用非严格可行性二分法加最终严格可行性恢复，显式构造 ε-最优稳定控制器。这回答了 Guo 和 Hu [2022] 的有限时间最优性差距，强化了原有定性理论。
papers.abstract_en: We study continuous-time full-order dynamic output-feedback $H_\infty$ policy search, a nonconvex and nonsmooth problem. Direct policy search is a central paradigm in reinforcement learning and continuous control, but rigorous guarantees remain scarce in robust output-feedback settings. The $H_\infty$ problem is a canonical benchmark because it captures disturbance attenuation and robustness while exposing the hard nonsmooth geometry of policy-space optimization. We prove that on the exact identity-gauge slice of the extended convex lift, $\varepsilon$-stationarity yields $O(\varepsilon)$-suboptimality on compact exact slices, which in turn yields convergence-rate guarantees for nonsmooth policy-search methods. This result addresses the finite-time optimality-gap question raised by Guo and Hu [2022] in the more general dynamic output-feedback $H_\infty$ policy-search setting. We further use the established value equivalence supplied by extended convex lifting to formulate a nonstrict-feasibility bisection method with one final strict-feasibility recovery step, yielding an explicit $\varepsilon$-optimal stabilizing controller. These results provide a quantitative and algorithmic strengthening of prior qualitative optimality theory for nonsmooth $H_\infty$ policy search.

papers.title_en: Localize, Restart, Accelerate: Stochastic Optimization under Generalized Smoothness
papers.authors: Darina Dvinskikh, Alexander Gasnikov, Aleksandr Lobanov, Ilgam Latypov
papers.evidence: 面向机器学习目标的广义光滑性随机优化
papers.tldr: 针对局部曲率随梯度范数增长的广义光滑随机凸优化，动量加速易进入高曲率区且随机梯度难以认证轨迹。提出 ARC-SG 两阶段加速法：先以广义光滑感知随机步压缩过大梯度，再在认证光滑球内重启加速求解强凸近端子问题。在高概率下取得加速优化贡献与对精度近最优的统计依赖，并恢复 L1=0 时经典加速随机率。贡献在于逐查询认证定位、显式参数核算与强凸重启保证。
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic convex optimization under asymmetric \((L_0,L_1)\)-generalized smoothness, a model motivated by machine-learning objectives whose local curvature may grow with the gradient norm. We assume an unbiased first-order oracle with additive norm-sub-Gaussian noise. Acceleration is difficult in this setting because momentum may enter regions of much larger curvature, while stochastic gradients cannot reliably certify an unrestricted trajectory. We propose \textsf{ARC-SG}, a two-phase accelerated method: Phase~I reduces excessively large gradients using a generalized-smoothness-aware stochastic step, then Phase~II solves strongly convex proximal subproblems by a restarted accelerated solver confined to certified smoothness balls. Exact proximal points do not increase the gradient norm, allowing these certificates to propagate through the outer loop. The contribution is a query-by-query certified-localization construction with explicit generalized-smoothness factors and a strongly convex restart extension. \textsf{ARC-SG} achieves, with high probability, an accelerated optimization contribution and smooth-subclass-optimal statistical dependence on accuracy, up to logarithmic and generalized-smoothness factors. Its convex accuracy exponents agree with a contemporaneous public stochastic-acceleration result under a broader smoothness and affine-variance model; our distinction is the certified geometry, explicit parameter accounting, and strongly convex guarantee. The results recover classical accelerated stochastic rates when \(L_1=0\). Experiments on objectives with unbounded gradients illustrate the two-phase mechanism and its finite-budget advantage.

papers.title_en: How to Make the Gradient Mapping Small for Constrained Stochastic Min-Max Problems and Beyond
papers.evidence: 极小极大优化与变分不等式的随机一阶复杂度
papers.tldr: 研究约束或正则化凸凹极小极大与随机单调变分不等式的随机一阶复杂度，以梯度映射（前向后向/自然残差）衡量次优性。此前约束情形达到 ε 精度需 Õ(ε^{-4})，而无约束近最优为 Õ(ε^{-2})。本文提出新算法与分析，将约束凸凹极小极大的梯度映射复杂度改进至 Õ(ε^{-2})。并借 Blum-Gladyshev 假设，在无有界方差时证明同样复杂度，弥合关键差距。
papers.abstract_en: We study the stochastic first-order oracle complexity for constrained or regularized convex-concave min-max optimization and stochastic monotone variational inequalities. We focus on the case when suboptimality is measured in terms of the gradient mapping, also known as, forward-backward or natural residual, an optimality notion that generalizes the gradient norm for unconstrained problems. In this setting, under standard unbiased oracle access with now-standard variance assumptions, the best-known complexity for making the norm of the gradient mapping less than $\varepsilon$ is $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$, compared to the near-optimal $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ that is established in the unconstrained case. We bridge this gap to improve the gradient mapping complexity for constrained convex-concave min-max problems to $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$. We then extend to prove the same complexity for problems without the bounded variance, by using the Blum-Gladyshev assumption.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical and Permutation-Invariant Feature Transformation Learning via Policy-Guided Embedding Search
papers.authors: Rui Liu, Tao Zhe, Yanyong Huang, Sankha Narayan Guria, Xiao Luo, Wei Fan, Yanjie Fu, Dongjie Wang
papers.tldr: 表格数据特征变换可提升预测性能，但现有生成式方法忽略低层特征、操作与高层抽象间的层次关系，对置换不变序列施加顺序敏感嵌入并依赖梯度搜索。本文提出PHER框架：用置换不变分层模块结合自注意力池化学习一致嵌入，再以策略引导多目标强化学习从强种子初始化并联合优化精度与效率。在多个表格基准上优于强基线，鲁棒有效。代码已开源。
papers.abstract_en: Feature transformation improves predictive performance on tabular data by constructing informative abstractions from raw features. Recent generative approaches encode transformation knowledge into continuous embedding spaces for efficient exploration of candidate strategies, but face three key limitations: (1) overlooking hierarchical relationships between low-level features, operations, and high-level abstractions; (2) enforcing order-sensitive embeddings on inherently permutation-invariant transformation sequences, thereby introducing systematic bias; and (3) relying on gradient-based search, which is ill-suited to non-convex transformation spaces. We propose a framework with two complementary components. First, a permutation-invariant hierarchical module captures interactions across features, operations, and abstraction levels, with a self-attention pooling mechanism that maps semantically equivalent structures to consistent embeddings aligned with downstream performance. Second, a policy-guided multi-objective reinforcement learning strategy initializes the search from empirically strong seeds and jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and transformation efficiency. Extensive experiments on diverse tabular benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our framework against strong baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/RayLiu1103/PHER.

papers.title_en: Weighted Empirical Risk Minimization for Machine Learning under Long-Range Dependence: Exact Pathwise Rates and Learning-Error Geometry
papers.evidence: 长程依赖数据下加权经验风险最小化的精确几乎必然随机分析理论
papers.tldr: 长程依赖数据下加权经验风险最小化（ERM）缺乏精确几乎必然学习理论。对平稳高斯序列有限窗、正则变化权重与平滑参数模型，利用Wiener混沌秩m和低频非零条件，将有限滞后得分约化为加权Hermite混沌。得到几乎必然Bahadur表示、参数精确limsup律及m≥2时学习轨道泛函聚集；多项式学习指数由记忆参数和混沌秩决定，对幂加权不变。尖锐路径常数与聚集几何依赖权重，秩一情形最优幂指数为正，并用于时间序列预测与分类。
papers.abstract_en: We develop an exact almost-sure learning theory for smooth parametric models trained by regularly weighted empirical risk minimization on long-range dependent data. The training observations are generated from a fixed finite window of a stationary Gaussian sequence, and the sample weights are regularly varying. If the loss gradient at the population minimizer has Wiener-chaos rank $m$ and a nonzero low-frequency coefficient, then, in the long-memory interior regime, the finite-lag score reduces on the iterated-logarithm scale to a single weighted Hermite chaos. This yields an almost-sure Bahadur representation, an exact limsup law for the learned parameter, and, for $m\ge2$, the functional cluster set of the complete learning trajectory. The polynomial learning exponent is determined by the memory parameter and the chaos rank and is invariant under the admissible power weighting, whereas the sharp pathwise constant and cluster geometry depend on the weights. In the rank-one case, global optimization over the admissible power exponents shows that every optimizer is positive. Time-series prediction and classification examples illustrate the results.
